Name: Shophach
Summary: Captain of the host of Hadarezer, slain by David's army.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 19:16; 1 Chronicles 19:18: Captain of the host of Hadarezer, slain by David's army.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shophach in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
